new_cases.title: Captain Schaffner's Lightning XS894 loss off Flamborough Head
new_cases.place: North Sea, c. 5 miles off Flamborough Head, East Yorkshire
new_cases.desc: On 8 September 1970, USAF exchange pilot Capt. William Schaffner flew Lightning XS894 from RAF Binbrook and went into the sea off Flamborough Head. The jet was found nearly intact with the canopy closed, but his body was never recovered. Later stories by Pat Otter and Tony Dodd said he was chasing a UFO and was taken from the cockpit. RAF inquiry files show a TACEVAL exercise against a Shackleton and a failed ejection seat. Coordinates are approximate.

new_cases.desc: On Christmas Eve 1975, pilot Peter Gibbs took off at night in a Cessna 150 from the unlit Glenforsa Hotel strip on Mull and vanished. The inquiry concluded he ditched and died of exposure, but the case has drawn UFO and teleportation theories.
